scope: model fixture executions, including retries; no primary review total
usage_scope: Last cumulative runtime usage per session. Cached input is part of input; reasoning is part of output. Tool execution seconds are per case, overlapping cases not added as a wall-clock batch total.
explicit_fixture_aggregation: Two rollout streams (Main usage matched CLI final turn, child usage matched second rollup). Old exporter used the parent ID again for the child; child identity and actual handoff in retained combined trace.
